chatbotResponses.cuidados:
🩹 Aftercare instructions:
1. Keep the protective film for 3-4 hours
2. Gently wash with neutral soap
3. Apply healing cream 2-3 times a day
4. Don't scratch or pull off scabs
5. Avoid direct sunlight for 2-3 weeks
6. Don't swim in pools/sea for 2 weeks

2. Eat well beforehand
